omens.omen_en: Avoid signing off on major logistics or supply chain changes.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不宜签署重大的物流或供应链变更协议。
omens.detail_en: Symbolizing movement over unstable ground. External factors beyond your control could lead to 'turbulence' in your project delivery.
omens.detail_zh: 象征在不稳定的基础上移动。今日那些你无法控制的外部因素，可能会导致项目交付出现‘动荡’。

omens.omen_en: Delay launching a campaign that relies on third-party platforms.
omens.omen_zh: 推迟发布那些高度依赖第三方平台的营销活动。
omens.detail_en: Do not trust a 'vessel' you don't own today. Platform outages or algorithm shifts could sink your efforts before they start.
omens.detail_zh: 今日不要轻信不属于你的‘载体’。平台故障或算法波动可能会在你行动之前就让你的努力化为乌有。

omens.omen_en: Refrain from engaging with toxic online communities or complaints.
omens.omen_zh: 避开负能量满满的网络社区或无休止的抱怨。
omens.detail_en: Modern 'sickness' is often mental. Absorbing others' negativity today will drain your own creative vitality and focus.
omens.detail_zh: 现代的‘病气’往往是精神上的。今日吸收他人的负能量，会严重损耗你自身的创作活力与专注力。

omens.omen_en: Do not offer advice to struggling colleagues or peers today.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不要向陷入困境的同事或同行提供建议。
omens.detail_en: Your empathy will be a drain today. You risk catching the same 'fatigue' or confusion without actually helping the other person.
omens.detail_zh: 今日你的同理心会成为一种消耗。你可能会染上同样的‘疲劳’或困惑，却没能真正帮到对方。

omens.omen_en: Avoid dwelling on past failures or sunsetting projects today.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不宜沉溺于过去的失败，或处理已被终结的项目。
omens.detail_en: Focusing on the 'dead' prevents you from seeing new life. Dwelling on what is gone will lower your frequency and morale.
omens.detail_zh: 过度关注‘逝去之物’会让你忽视新生。纠结于已成定局之事会降低你的能量频率与士气。

omens.omen_en: Postpone any public 'goodbye' or final closure announcements.
omens.omen_zh: 推迟任何公开的‘告别’或最终终止的声明。
omens.detail_en: Endings under this influence feel heavier than they should. Wait for a more neutral day to close a chapter permanently.
omens.detail_zh: 在此能量下进行的终结会比预期更沉重。请等待一个更中性的日子再彻底结束某个篇章。

omens.omen_en: Delay sending that confrontational email or legal notice.
omens.omen_zh: 推迟发送那封带有对抗性的邮件或法律告知函。
omens.detail_en: Conflict initiated today is likely to become prolonged and draining. Seek mediation rather than escalating a dispute.
omens.detail_zh: 今日开启的冲突极易演变成旷日持久的消耗战。此时与其升级争端，不如寻求中立调解。

omens.omen_en: Avoid engaging in heated debates on social media.
omens.omen_zh: 避开在社交媒体上进行激烈的争辩。
omens.detail_en: Arguments today are unlikely to be won. You will likely lose focus and peace of mind without changing anyone's opinion.
omens.detail_zh: 今日的争论很难胜出。你可能会在无法改变任何人观点的情况下，白白损失专注力与内心的平静。

omens.omen_en: Maintain the status quo; avoid any high-stakes decisions.
omens.omen_zh: 维持现状；避开任何高风险的决策。
omens.detail_en: The energy of the day is chaotic. Any major move made now is like building on sand—wait for a clearer day to act.
omens.detail_zh: 今日能量紊乱。此时采取重大行动无异于沙上筑塔——请静待时机明朗再行事。

omens.omen_en: Clear your calendar of anything that requires intense focus.
omens.omen_zh: 清空日程表中那些需要高度专注的任务。
omens.detail_en: When nothing is favored, rest is the only win. Use today for low-impact chores or simple recovery instead of deep work.
omens.detail_zh: 当万事不宜时，休息是唯一的胜利。今日宜做琐碎家务或简单修整，而非深度工作。

omens.omen_en: Avoid purchasing new subscriptions or expensive hardware today.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不宜购买新的订阅服务或高昂的硬件设备。
omens.detail_en: A purchase made today may come with hidden maintenance issues or immediate buyers' remorse.
omens.detail_zh: 今日购买的设备或服务可能带有隐形的维护难题，或让你迅速产生消费悔意。

omens.omen_en: Do not commit to a new car lease or long-term transport plan.
omens.omen_zh: 不要签署新的购车租赁合同或长期交通计划。
omens.detail_en: The 'vehicle' chosen today may prove to be inefficient or more burdensome than originally expected.
omens.detail_zh: 今日选择的‘载具’可能会被证明效率低下，或比最初预期的负担更重。

omens.omen_en: Skip networking events that feel forced or purely transactional.
omens.omen_zh: 避开那些让你感到强迫或纯粹交易性质的社交活动。
omens.detail_en: Social energy is low. Interactions today may lead to misunderstandings or a feeling of being 'drained' instead of supported.
omens.detail_zh: 社交能量低迷。今日的互动容易引发误解，或让你感到精疲力竭，而非获得支持。

omens.omen_en: Avoid introducing new people to your core inner circle.
omens.omen_zh: 避开在今日向你的核心圈子介绍新朋友。
omens.detail_en: First impressions made today might be skewed. Let relationships develop naturally on a day with better alignment.
omens.detail_zh: 今日留下的第一印象可能会产生偏差。请在能量更契合的日子里，让关系自然发展。

omens.omen_en: Do not enter into long-term exclusive partnerships today.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不宜建立长期的排他性合作伙伴关系。
omens.detail_en: Binding your future to another under this influence can lead to friction. Wait for a more harmonious day to pledge loyalty.
omens.detail_zh: 在此能量下将未来与他人绑定易生摩擦。请等待一个更和谐的吉日再签署长期契约。

omens.omen_en: Postpone announcing a permanent merger or joint venture.
omens.omen_zh: 推迟宣布永久性的合并或合资计划。
omens.detail_en: The union may start with hidden imbalances. A delay today ensures the foundation is checked once more before the 'vow'.
omens.detail_zh: 这种联合可能从一开始就带有隐形的失衡。今日的推迟能确保在正式‘结盟’前再次检查根基。

omens.omen_en: Postpone difficult conversations about chores or household 'messes'.
omens.omen_zh: 推迟关于家务或家庭‘烂摊子’的艰难谈话。
omens.detail_en: Uncovering messy situations today will only lead to unpleasant arguments. Let the 'waste' sit until everyone is in a calmer mood.
omens.detail_zh: 今日揭开混乱的局面只会引发不愉快的争吵。先让这些‘垃圾’待着，直到大家的绪都平静下来。

omens.omen_en: Avoid engaging in gossip or 'venting' sessions about colleagues.
omens.omen_zh: 避开参与有关同事的八卦或‘吐槽’环节。
omens.detail_en: Releasing 'waste' verbally today will likely backfire, polluting your own reputation more than the target's.
omens.detail_zh: 今日口头释放‘垃圾’极易产生反作用，比起目标人物，这更容易污染你自己的名声。

omens.omen_en: Avoid ignoring feedback or 'closing off' your communication channels.
omens.omen_zh: 不要忽视反馈，也不要‘关闭’你的沟通渠道。
omens.detail_en: Today, being too rigid or unapproachable will cause you to miss a vital piece of information from your users or team.
omens.detail_zh: 今日若表现得过于死板或拒人千里，会让你错过来自用户或团队的关键信息。

omens.omen_en: Do not suppress a minor bug or error to save face.
omens.omen_zh: 不要为了面子而压制一个小错误或漏洞。
omens.detail_en: Blocking the problem today will only cause it to build pressure and explode later. Address it openly or wait for a better day to fix it.
omens.detail_zh: 今日封堵问题只会让压力积聚并在日后爆发。应公开处理，或等待吉日彻底修复。

omens.omen_en: Avoid verbal agreements or handshake deals today.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不宜达成口头协议或仅凭握手成交。
omens.detail_en: Alliances formed under this influence are prone to shifting terms. Ensure everything is documented or wait for a more stable day to commit.
omens.detail_zh: 在此影响下建立的盟约极易出现条款变动。请确保所有事项都有记录，或等待更稳定的日子再行承诺。

omens.omen_en: Postpone joining a new professional collective or guild.
omens.omen_zh: 推迟加入新的职业团体或行业协会。
omens.detail_en: Entering a 'covenant' today may result in mismatched expectations. Research the group further before formally tying your brand to theirs.
omens.detail_zh: 今日‘入盟’可能导致预期不符。在正式将你的品牌与对方绑定之前，请对该团体进行更深入的调研。

omens.omen_en: Avoid making large withdrawals or moving significant capital.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不宜进行大额提现或转移重大资金。
omens.detail_en: The energy of 'receiving' is blocked. Wealth moved today tends to leak away or be mismanaged; keep your assets stationary.
omens.detail_zh: ‘收纳’的能量受阻。今日流动的财富往往容易流失或被误管；请保持资产静止。

omens.omen_en: Do not accept a new investment offer without extreme vetting.
omens.omen_zh: 未经极其严苛的审核，不要接受新的投资邀约。
omens.detail_en: Money entering your 'storage' today might come with hidden strings or high long-term costs that outweigh the immediate gain.
omens.detail_zh: 今日进入‘金库’的资金可能带有隐性限制，或其长期成本将超过眼前的收益。

omens.omen_en: Postpone hiring permanent staff or long-term contractors.
omens.omen_zh: 推迟招聘正式员工或长期承包商。
omens.detail_en: Anciently about livestock; modernly about productivity. Those 'onboarded' today may struggle to integrate or meet performance standards.
omens.detail_zh: 古时指牧畜，现代指产能。今日‘入职’的人员可能难以融入团队或难以达到绩效标准。

omens.omen_en: Avoid purchasing automated software or production bots.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不宜购买自动化软件或生产类机器人。
omens.detail_en: New 'tools of labor' acquired today are likely to malfunction or require excessive maintenance, hindering rather than helping your flow.
omens.detail_zh: 今日获取的新‘劳动力工具’极易发生故障或需要过度维护，反而会阻碍你的工作流。

omens.omen_en: Do not sign long-term service agreements or leases today.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不宜签署长期服务协议或租赁合同。
omens.detail_en: The fine print is particularly dangerous today. A contract signed now may lock you into unfavorable terms for months to come.
omens.detail_zh: 今日的附加条款尤为危险。现在签署的合同可能会让你在接下来的数月中陷入不利的境地。

omens.omen_en: Avoid renewing subscriptions or recurring payment plans.
omens.omen_zh: 避开在今日续订订阅服务或经常性支付计划。
omens.detail_en: Automatic commitments made today are often forgotten or underutilized. Audit your needs before letting the 'bond' renew.
omens.detail_zh: 今日达成的自动续约往往会被遗忘或利用率低下。在让‘契约’延续前，请先审计你的实际需求。

omens.omen_en: Avoid a major haircut or change in personal grooming style.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不宜大幅度剪发或改变个人理容风格。
omens.detail_en: Cutting your 'threads' today results in a loss of vital energy. You may feel physically weaker or less confident after a trim today.
omens.detail_zh: 今日剪断‘发丝’会导致元气流失。修剪后你可能会感到身体虚弱或自信心下降。

omens.omen_en: Do not 'trim' your project scope or feature list today.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不要‘修剪’你的项目范围或功能列表。
omens.detail_en: Decisions to cut features made today are often reactive rather than strategic. You may regret losing a key component later.
omens.detail_zh: 今日做出的削减功能的决定往往是反应性的而非战略性的。你日后可能会后悔失去了某个关键组件。

omens.omen_en: Postpone the launch of your website or store front.
omens.omen_zh: 推迟你的网站或店面的正式发布。
omens.detail_en: Opening to the public today attracts 'noise' rather than quality leads. A quiet soft-launch is better than a grand opening under this influence.
omens.detail_zh: 今日向公众开放吸引的是‘噪音’而非高质量线索。在此影响下，低调试运行优于盛大开幕。

omens.omen_en: Avoid announcing a new business venture on social media.
omens.omen_zh: 避开在社交媒体上宣布新的创业项目。
omens.detail_en: Visibility today may lead to premature scrutiny. Keep your 'doors closed' and refine your message until the energy clears.
omens.detail_zh: 今日的曝光可能会引来过早的审查。请保持‘闭门’状态并精炼你的信息，直到能量转晴。

omens.omen_en: Avoid setting the roadmap for a major new project today.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不宜为一个重大的新项目设定路线图。
omens.detail_en: The foundation laid today is likely to be uneven. Future milestones built on this roadmap will be difficult to hit due to early planning errors.
omens.detail_zh: 今日奠定的基础极易出现偏差。基于此路线图的未来里程碑将因早期的规划错误而难以达成。

omens.omen_en: Do not commit to the core technology stack of your app today.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不要敲定你应用的核心技术栈。
omens.detail_en: Foundational choices made now may become restrictive 'legacy' issues very quickly. Keep your options open for a few more days.
omens.detail_zh: 现在做出的底层选择可能会迅速演变成限制性的‘遗留’问题。请让你的选项多保留几天。

omens.omen_en: Avoid making grand, public declarations of your intentions.
omens.omen_zh: 避开对你的意图进行宏大且公开的宣告。
omens.detail_en: Seeking 'blessings' or validation too early today can dissipate your internal drive. Keep your goals private and build your strength in silence.
omens.detail_zh: 今日过早寻求‘加持’或认可会耗散你的内在动力。请保持目标私密，在沉默中积蓄力量。

omens.omen_en: Do not rely on luck or 'manifestation' for a deadline.
omens.omen_zh: 不要在截止日期面前依赖运气或‘显化’。
omens.detail_en: Passive waiting for a breakthrough will fail today. Replace 'prayer' with hard logic and practical debugging to save your project.
omens.detail_zh: 今日消极等待突破将会失败。请用严密的逻辑和务实的代码调试取代‘祈祷’，以此拯救你的项目。

omens.omen_en: Avoid starting a high-stakes leadership role on a new team today.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不宜在新的团队中担任高风险的领导职务。
omens.detail_en: The 'first impression' energy is unstable. Taking authority today may lead to immediate friction or a lack of natural respect from subordinates.
omens.detail_zh: ‘第一印象’的能量极度不稳定。今日确立权威可能会导致即时摩擦，或令下属难以产生天然的敬意。

omens.omen_en: Do not accept new administrative powers or permissions today.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不宜接受新的行政权力或系统权限。
omens.detail_en: New responsibilities assumed now may come with hidden liabilities. Wait for a clearer day to take the 'keys' to a new system.
omens.detail_zh: 现在接手的重任可能带有隐性责任。请等待更明朗的日子，再接管新系统的‘钥匙’。

omens.omen_en: Postpone deleting legacy archives or sunsetting a long-term project.
omens.omen_zh: 推迟删除旧档案或终结某个长期项目。
omens.detail_en: Breaking ground for an ending today may be premature. You might realize tomorrow that a piece of that 'dead' project was still vital.
omens.detail_zh: 今日为终结‘破土’可能为时过早。你明天可能会发现，那个‘已死’项目中的某个部分依然至关重要。

omens.omen_en: Avoid finalizing a 'post-mortem' or failure analysis report.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不宜定稿‘复盘’报告或故障分析报告。
omens.detail_en: Your perspective on what went wrong is currently skewed. Finalizing the report now may lead to incorrect blame or missing the root cause.
omens.detail_zh: 你目前对错误原因的看法存在偏差。此时定稿报告可能会导致错误的归责，或遗漏根本原因。

omens.omen_en: Avoid 'seeding' a new creative concept in a brainstorming session.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不宜在脑暴会议中‘播种’新的创意概念。
omens.detail_en: Concepts conceived today are likely to be 'weak' or lack a clear growth path. Save your best sparks for a more fertile day.
omens.detail_zh: 今日构思的概念往往‘底气不足’或缺乏清晰的成长路径。请将你最好的火花留给更丰饶的日子。

omens.omen_en: Do not start the initial development of a 'brainchild' project.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不要开始某个‘创意结晶’项目的初步开发。
omens.detail_en: Early-stage nurturing is critical. Starting today will feel uphill, and you may lose passion for the project before it ever matures.
omens.detail_zh: 早期孵化至关重要。今日起步会让你感到举步维艰，项目尚未成熟你可能就已失去热情。

omens.omen_en: Avoid drastic new experimental treatments or unproven software fixes.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不宜尝试激进的新型实验性疗法或未经证实的软件修复方案。
omens.detail_en: Seeking a 'cure' today may lead to side effects. Stick to traditional, stable methods rather than chasing a 'miracle' solution right now.
omens.detail_zh: 今日求索‘良方’可能带来副作用。请坚持传统稳定的方法，而非现在就去追求所谓的‘奇迹’方案。

omens.omen_en: Do not consult a new 'expert' whose values you haven't vetted.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不要咨询那些你尚未审核过价值观的新‘专家’。
omens.detail_en: Advice received today may be technically sound but strategically toxic for your specific situation. Stick with trusted advisors.
omens.detail_zh: 今日收到的建议可能在技术上成立，但对你的具体情况而言却具有战略毒性。请信任老顾问。

omens.omen_en: Postpone major UI/UX redesigns or structural refactors.
omens.omen_zh: 推迟重大的 UI/UX 重新设计或结构性代码重构。
omens.detail_en: Renovating the 'house' today leads to hidden structural damage. You may break more features than you fix during the overhaul.
omens.detail_zh: 今日装修‘门面’会导致隐形的结构性损伤。在彻底大修期间，你损坏的功能可能比修复的还要多。

omens.omen_en: Avoid making changes to your physical office layout.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不宜改变办公室的物理布局。
omens.detail_en: External shifts today mirror internal chaos. Keep your environment stable to prevent a drop in your team's throughput.
omens.detail_zh: 外在的变动会映射内在的混乱。请保持环境稳定，以防团队产出率下降。

omens.omen_en: Avoid settling into a long-term routine or 'resting' on your laurels.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不宜陷入长期的常规模式或‘躺在功劳簿上’止步不前。
omens.detail_en: Setting the 'bed' today invites stagnation rather than recovery. If you stop moving now, you may find it impossible to restart tomorrow.
omens.detail_zh: 今日‘安床’招来的是停滞而非恢复。如果你现在停止脚步，明天可能会发现极难重新启动。

omens.omen_en: Avoid committing to a long-term habit or a permanent lifestyle change.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不宜承诺建立长期习惯或进行永久性的生活方式改变。
omens.detail_en: Setting your 'rest' today leads to stagnation. Lifestyle choices made now may become a burden rather than a source of comfort.
omens.detail_zh: 今日‘安床’会导致停滞。现在做出的生活方式选择可能会变成一种负担，而非舒适的来源。

omens.omen_en: Avoid throwing away old mementos or sentimental belongings.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不宜丢弃旧纪念品或带有情感寄托的物品。
omens.detail_en: Final goodbyes are too heavy today. You may regret 'burying' these memories once the current emotional fog clears.
omens.detail_zh: 今日的‘告别’过于沉重。一旦当前的情感迷雾消散，你可能会后悔‘埋葬’了这些回忆。

omens.omen_en: Do not ignore the 'lessons learned' from a failed project.
omens.omen_zh: 不要忽视从失败项目中吸取的‘教训’。
omens.detail_en: Burying the failure without studying it today ensures it will happen again. Face the remains of the project before you hide them.
omens.detail_zh: 今日若不加研究就掩埋失败，势必导致重蹈覆辙。在隐藏项目残骸前，请先直面它们。

omens.omen_en: Avoid sacrificing your health or sleep for a minor deadline.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不宜为了一个小小的期限而牺牲健康或睡眠。
omens.detail_en: A 'sacrifice' made today will not be rewarded by the universe. You will end up burned out without actually improving the project's quality.
omens.detail_zh: 今日做出的‘牺牲’不会得到宇宙的回馈。你最终会因倦怠而倒下，且并不能实质性提升项目质量。

omens.omen_en: Do not rely on old traditions or 'the way it's always been done'.
omens.omen_zh: 不要依赖旧传统或‘一直以来都是这么做的’老路子。
omens.detail_en: Blindly following the past is a hollow ritual today. Adapt to the current market reality instead of performing 'ceremonies' for an obsolete model.
omens.detail_zh: 今日盲从过去只是一场空洞的仪式。请适应当前的市场现实，而非为过时的模式举行‘祭礼’。

omens.omen_en: Avoid dismantling a working system or legacy feature today.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不宜拆除仍在运行的系统或遗留功能。
omens.detail_en: Tearing down the 'house' today is high risk. You may find that the replacement isn't ready, leaving you without a stable structure for your workflow.
omens.detail_zh: 今日拆除‘旧屋’风险极高。你可能会发现替代方案尚未就绪，导致你的工作流失去稳定的支撑结构。

omens.omen_en: Do not break off a long-term business relationship in a moment of anger.
omens.omen_zh: 不要在愤怒之下断绝长期的商业合作关系。
omens.detail_en: Demolition under this influence is irreversible and messy. Wait for a cooler head to decide if the bridge truly needs to be burned.
omens.detail_zh: 在此影响下进行的拆解是不可逆且混乱的。请等冷静下来后再决定是否真的需要破釜沉舟。

omens.omen_en: Avoid building 'walls' between yourself and your collaborators.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不宜在你与合作者之间筑起‘高墙’。
omens.detail_en: Building a levee today creates isolation, not safety. Over-protecting your ideas now will prevent the flow of vital external feedback.
omens.detail_zh: 今日筑堤带来的是孤立而非安全。过度保护你的创意会阻碍至关重要的外部反馈流向你。

omens.omen_en: Do not implement overly restrictive user permissions today.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不要实施过于严苛的用户权限限制。
omens.detail_en: Attempts to control the 'flow' today will backfire and cause a user revolt. Maintain a flexible barrier instead of a hard dam.
omens.detail_zh: 今日试图控制‘流量’的行为会适得其反，引发用户反弹。请保持灵活的屏障而非生硬的阻拦。

omens.omen_en: Avoid asking for too much personal info from new users today.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不宜向新用户索取过多的个人信息。
omens.detail_en: Inquiring after 'identities' today creates distrust. Keep your onboarding light to prevent a high bounce rate.
omens.detail_zh: 今日过分询问‘身份详情’会制造不信任感。请简化入职流程，以防用户流失率升高。

omens.omen_en: Do not pry into a partner's private data or history today.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不要窥探合作伙伴的私密数据或历史记录。
omens.detail_en: Information gathered through prying today will be misinterpreted. Respect boundaries to maintain the integrity of the alliance.
omens.detail_zh: 今日通过窥探获得的信息会被误读。请尊重边界，以维护联盟的完整性。

omens.omen_en: Avoid 'taking off' your professional guard or safety protocols.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不宜放下你的职业戒备或安全规程。
omens.detail_en: Shedding your protection today leaves you vulnerable. Do not let down your guard until you are certain the 'mourning' period is truly over.
omens.detail_zh: 今日卸下防护会让你暴露在风险中。在确定‘服丧期’真正结束前，请不要放松警惕。

omens.omen_en: Do not rush out of a period of rest or recovery today.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不宜仓促结束休息或康复期。
omens.detail_en: Leaving your 'protective mode' too early will lead to a relapse. Ensure you are 100% healed before returning to high-stress activities.
omens.detail_zh: 过早脱离‘保护模式’会导致病情反复。在回归高压力活动前，请确保你已 100% 康复。

omens.omen_en: Avoid cutting out 'toxic' people from your life in a moment of heat.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不宜在冲动之下将‘负能量’的人清理出你的生活。
omens.detail_en: Cleansing your social circle today is too aggressive. You may cause more drama and 'infestation' of rumors than if you stayed quiet.
omens.detail_zh: 今日清理社交圈过于激进。比起保持沉默，这样做可能会引发更多的纠纷和流言蜚语。

omens.omen_en: Do not attempt to 'fix' a toxic person's behavior today.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不要尝试去‘修复’一个充满负能量的人的行为。
omens.detail_en: Engaging with 'social pests' today will only transfer the infestation to you. Block or distance yourself instead of trying to 'clean' the situation.
omens.detail_zh: 今日与‘社交害虫’纠缠只会让麻烦转移到你身上。请直接拉黑或远离，而非试图‘净化’局面。

omens.omen_en: Avoid finalizing the core framework of a new project today.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不宜敲定新项目的核心框架。
omens.detail_en: The 'main beam' must be perfectly aligned. Under this influence, structural flaws are likely to be built into the foundation of your work.
omens.detail_zh: ‘大梁’必须绝对对齐。在此影响下，结构性缺陷极易被植入到你工作的根基中。

omens.omen_en: Avoid making high-stakes family decisions or long-term commitments.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不宜做出重大的家庭决策或长期承诺。
omens.detail_en: The 'main beam' supports the house. Today, the foundation of your judgment is shaky; wait for a clearer day to decide on life-altering plans.
omens.detail_zh: ‘上梁’支撑全屋。今日你的判断基准并不稳固，涉及改变人生的重大计划请等头脑清醒时再定。

omens.omen_en: Avoid viewing new properties or making an offer today.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不宜看房或提交购房报价。
omens.detail_en: Hidden defects are obscured today. You may be blinded by a 'surface-level' beauty and miss a major structural or legal issue.
omens.detail_zh: 今日隐形缺陷会被掩盖。你可能会被‘表面’的美丽所迷惑，而忽视重大的结构或法律问题。

omens.omen_en: Do not sign long-term mortgage or property-related documents.
omens.omen_zh: 不要签署长期抵押贷款或与房产相关的法律文件。
omens.detail_en: The financial burden tied to a property today will feel heavier than expected. Wait for a day with better flow.
omens.detail_zh: 今日绑定的房产财务负担会比预期更沉重。请等待能量流转更顺畅的日子。

omens.omen_en: Avoid purchasing high-end professional attire or branding assets.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不宜购买高端职业装或品牌资产。
omens.detail_en: Items bought today may not suit your future 'identity'. You might find the style feels outdated or ill-fitting very quickly.
omens.detail_zh: 今日购买的物品可能不符合你未来的‘身份’。你可能会很快发现风格过时或不合身。

omens.omen_en: Avoid changing your public image or trying a radical new look.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不宜剧烈改变公众形象或尝试极端的全新造型。
omens.detail_en: First impressions made today may feel 'off' later. Stick to your usual style rather than investing in a wardrobe or identity shift you might regret.
omens.detail_zh: 今日留下的第一印象日后可能会让人觉得‘不对劲’。建议维持原有风格，不要投资可能会让你后悔的服饰或形象转变。

omens.omen_en: Avoid bulk purchases of stock or crypto today.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不宜大宗买入股票或加密货币。
omens.detail_en: The market energy is deceptive. What looks like a dip might be a trap. Keep your capital liquid and wait.
omens.detail_zh: 市场能量具有欺骗性。看起来像是抄底的机会可能是一个陷阱。请保持资金流动并等待。

omens.omen_en: Do not sell a major asset in a hurry today.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不要急于出售重大资产。
omens.detail_en: A sale made under pressure today will likely be at an undervalued price. Hold your ground to maximize long-term gains.
omens.detail_zh: 今日在压力下达成的交易很可能价格偏低。请坚守立场，以实现长期利益最大化。

omens.omen_en: Avoid 'cutting down' a feature that is currently underperforming.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不宜‘砍掉’目前表现不佳的功能。
omens.detail_en: Your judgment of what is 'useless' is skewed today. You might destroy a resource that would have been vital in the next quarter.
omens.detail_zh: 今日你对‘无用之物’的判断存在偏差。你可能会毁掉一个在下一季度至关重要的资源。

omens.omen_en: Do not terminate a subscription or service provider today.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不要终止任何订阅或服务提供商。
omens.detail_en: The 'bridge' you burn today will be hard to rebuild. Wait until you have a confirmed replacement before cutting ties.
omens.detail_zh: 今日拆掉的‘桥梁’将很难重建。在切断联系之前，请确保已有确定的替代方案。

omens.omen_en: Avoid committing to the core schedule of a major personal project.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不宜敲定个人重大项目标核心时间表。
omens.detail_en: The 'beam' determines the strength of the structure. Setting deadlines today will lead to a rigid plan that breaks under the first sign of real-world pressure.
omens.detail_zh: ‘梁’决定了结构的强度。今日设定截止日期会导致计划过于僵化，一旦遇到现实压力便会分崩离析。

omens.omen_en: Avoid outlining the core structure of a major new personal goal.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不宜为重大的个人新目标制定核心架构。
omens.detail_en: Building the skeleton of a project today leads to structural flaws. Your plan may lack the balance needed to sustain long-term pressure.
omens.detail_zh: 今日搭建项目的骨架容易出现结构性缺陷。你的计划可能缺乏承受长期压力所需的平衡感。

omens.omen_en: Avoid setting up your new home office or 'creative engine'.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不宜布置新的家庭办公室或‘创意引擎’。
omens.detail_en: The hearth is where the energy is processed. A workspace set up today will feel cluttered and uninspiring over time.
omens.detail_zh: 炉灶是处理能量的地方。今日布置的工作空间随着时间的推移会显得凌乱且缺乏灵感。

omens.omen_en: Do not finalize your monetization strategy or 'revenue engine'.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不要敲定你的变现策略或‘收入引擎’。
omens.detail_en: The 'fuel' for your business is at risk of leaking. Ensure your revenue models are leak-proof before committing.
omens.detail_zh: 业务的‘燃料’存在流失风险。在投入之前，请确保你的收入模型没有漏洞。

omens.omen_en: Avoid trying to 'fix' your reputation for a past mistake.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不宜试图‘修复’因过去错误而受损的名声。
omens.detail_en: Attempting to re-write history today will only draw attention to the original error. Let the past rest for now.
omens.detail_zh: 今日试图重写历史只会让人们注意到最初的错误。暂时让过去的事尘埃落定。

omens.omen_en: Do not update the documentation for a project you've already closed.
omens.omen_zh: 不要为已经关闭的项目更新文档。
omens.detail_en: Digging into the past today will only uncover frustrations. Focus your energy on your current build instead.
omens.detail_zh: 今日挖掘过去只会发现挫败感。请将精力集中在当前的建设上。

omens.omen_en: Avoid archiving a project without a proper 'final review'.
omens.omen_zh: 在没有进行‘最终评审’的情况下，不宜将项目归档。
omens.detail_en: Closing the 'casket' too soon leads to forgotten tasks. Ensure all loose ends are truly tied before you walk away.
omens.detail_zh: 过早‘合棺’会导致遗忘任务。在离开前，请确保所有未了结的事项都已真正处理完毕。

omens.omen_en: Do not delete your project's 'history' or 'git logs' today.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不要删除项目的‘历史记录’或‘git 日志’。
omens.detail_en: You may need to reference the 'dead' code sooner than you think. Keep the records intact for future debugging.
omens.detail_zh: 你可能比想象中更早需要参考这些‘失效’代码。请保留完整记录以备日后调试。

omens.omen_en: Avoid moving expensive valuables or family heirlooms.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不宜搬动贵重物品或传家宝。
omens.detail_en: Moving the 'fire' of a household is sensitive. Items moved today are prone to breakage or being misplaced during the transition.
omens.detail_zh: 迁动家中的‘香火’十分敏感。今日搬运的物品极易出现破损或在搬运过程中遗失。

omens.omen_en: Avoid changing the location of your home safety equipment or altars.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不宜更动家中安全设备或祭坛的位置。
omens.detail_en: The spiritual and physical protection of your home is at a crossroads. Disrupting these 'anchors' today invites a period of vulnerability and unease.
omens.detail_zh: 家中的精神与物理防护正处于十字路口。今日扰动这些‘锚点’会招致一段时期的脆弱与不安。

omens.omen_en: Avoid starting a long-distance business trip or overseas flight.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不宜开启远距离出差或海外航行。
omens.detail_en: Movement today is prone to delays and lost baggage. If travel is necessary, double-check your documents and allow for extra transit time.
omens.detail_zh: 今日出行极易遭遇延误或丢件。若必须出行，请务必反复核对证件并预留充足的中转时间。

omens.omen_en: Do not sign a new vehicle lease or transit agreement today.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不宜签署新的车辆租赁或交通物流协议。
omens.detail_en: The path forward is obscured. Agreements made today regarding transportation may contain hidden fees or unfavorable exit clauses.
omens.detail_zh: 前行之路模糊不清。今日达成的交通协议可能包含隐藏费用或不利的退出条款。

omens.omen_en: Avoid fulfilling large wholesale orders or major inventory shipments.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不宜交付大宗批发订单或进行重大库存出货。
omens.detail_en: Releasing goods today carries a high risk of damage during transit or payment disputes upon arrival.
omens.detail_zh: 今日出货在运输过程中损坏或到货后产生支付纠纷的风险极高。

omens.omen_en: Do not finalize a refund or return of expensive equipment.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不要完成高昂设备的退款或退货手续。
omens.detail_en: The energy of 'releasing wealth' is unstable. You may find that the returned assets are worth less than documented, or the refund process stalls.
omens.detail_zh: ‘出财’能量不稳。你可能会发现退回的资产价值低于记录，或退款流程陷入停滞。

omens.omen_en: Avoid splitting your team into separate workstreams today.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不宜将团队拆分为独立的职能流水线。
omens.detail_en: Division leads to fragmentation today. Breaking up a unified group now will cause critical communication gaps that lead to project failure.
omens.detail_zh: 今日分工会导致碎片化。现在拆散统一的团队会造成关键的沟通断层，进而导致项目失败。

omens.omen_en: Do not move out of a shared office or co-working space.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不要搬离共享办公室或共用空间。
omens.detail_en: Ending a shared living or working arrangement today invites isolation. You may lose access to vital shared resources prematurely.
omens.detail_zh: 今日结束共事或共处关系会招致孤立。你可能会过早地失去对关键共享资源的访问权。

omens.omen_en: Avoid starting a new construction phase or physical renovation.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不宜开启新的建筑阶段或实体装修。
omens.detail_en: Disturbing the 'earth' today invites systemic instability. Any physical digging or foundation work started now will require rework later.
omens.detail_zh: 今日动土会招致系统性不稳。现在开始的任何挖掘或基础工程日后都需要返工。

omens.omen_en: Avoid starting any physical renovation or major garden digging.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不宜开启任何实体装修或重大的园艺挖掘。
omens.detail_en: Disturbing the ground today invites chaos into your living space. Physical changes started now will likely meet unexpected obstacles or delays.
omens.detail_zh: 今日动土会给居住空间带来混乱。现在开启的实体变动极易遇到意外阻碍或延误。

omens.omen_en: Avoid finalizing a merge or partnership between two brands.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不宜敲定两个品牌之间的合并或合伙事宜。
omens.detail_en: The alignment of values is deceptive today. A union formed now may look good on paper but will suffer from cultural friction.
omens.detail_zh: 今日价值观的对齐具有欺骗性。现在达成的联合看起来很美，但会遭受文化磨合的痛苦。

omens.omen_en: Do not announce a long-term commitment to a single vendor.
omens.omen_zh: 不要宣布对单一供应商的长期承诺。
omens.detail_en: Pledging loyalty today is a trap. You may find a much better partner next week, but the 'vow' made today will be hard to break.
omens.detail_zh: 今日宣誓效忠是个陷阱。你下周可能会遇到更好的伙伴，但今日许下的诺言将难以推翻。

omens.omen_en: Avoid preparing 'contingency plans' for your business's failure.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不宜为企业的倒闭起草‘应急预案’。
omens.detail_en: Preparing for the 'end' today attracts negative energy. Focus on survival and growth rather than obsessing over failure scenarios.
omens.detail_zh: 今日为‘终结’做准备会吸引负能量。请专注于生存与增长，而非痴迷于失败情境。

omens.omen_en: Do not finalize a life insurance policy or pension will today.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不要定稿人寿保险保单或养老遗嘱。
omens.detail_en: Matters concerning the distant future are clouded today. You may choose terms that are unnecessarily restrictive or expensive.
omens.detail_zh: 今日关乎遥远未来的事务非常模糊。你可能会选择不必要的限制性或昂贵的条款。

omens.omen_en: Avoid trying to mediate between two conflicting social circles.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不宜尝试在两个冲突的社交圈之间进行调解。
omens.detail_en: The point where two sides meet is weak today. Attempting to bridge a gap now may cause the conflict to collapse onto you instead.
omens.detail_zh: 两方交汇点今日极其脆弱。此时尝试弥合裂痕，可能会让冲突反而倒向你自己。

omens.omen_en: Do not close the final deal on a complex structural project.
omens.omen_zh: 不要就一个复杂的结构性项目达成最终交易。
omens.detail_en: Finishing the 'top' of a structure today is premature. Ensure the supports are 100% solid before you add the final weight.
omens.detail_zh: 今日为建筑‘封顶’为时过早。在增加最后的重量前，请确保支撑结构 100% 稳固。

omens.omen_en: Avoid setting final boundaries in a personal relationship.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不宜在个人关系中设定最终的界限。
omens.detail_en: Setting 'curtains' today may trap the wrong feelings inside. Your emotional boundaries might be too rigid or ill-placed under this energy.
omens.detail_zh: 今日‘设帐’可能会将错误的情绪困在其中。在此能量下，你的情感边界可能会显得过于死板或放错了位置。

omens.omen_en: Do not buy expensive curtains or interior decor for your office.
omens.omen_zh: 不要为办公室购买昂贵的窗帘或室内装饰品。
omens.detail_en: Items bought for 'hiding' or 'covering' will be of poor quality or the wrong color under today's energy.
omens.detail_zh: 在今日的能量下，为了‘遮掩’或‘覆盖’而购买的物品质量会很差，或者颜色不对。

omens.omen_en: Avoid finalizing the design of a creative gift or personal artwork.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不宜定稿创意礼物或个人艺术作品的设计。
omens.detail_en: Your sense of proportion and beauty is skewed today. What you create now may feel uninspired or 'wrong' by tomorrow morning.
omens.detail_zh: 今日你对比例和美感的感知存在偏差。现在创作的作品到明天早晨可能会让你觉得缺乏灵感或‘不太对劲’。

omens.omen_en: Do not commission a new brand logo or corporate identity.
omens.omen_zh: 不要委派新的品牌 Logo 或企业形象设计。
omens.detail_en: The 'image' created today will lack soul or fail to represent your true mission. Wait for a more inspired day for artistic work.
omens.detail_zh: 今日创造的‘形象’会缺乏灵魂，或无法代表你的真实使命。请等待一个更具灵感的日子进行艺术创作。

omens.omen_en: Avoid installing new specialized software or hardware components.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不宜安装新的专业软件或硬件组件。
omens.detail_en: Mechanical and digital integrations are prone to friction today. A new tool installed now will likely cause compatibility errors.
omens.detail_zh: 今日机械与数字整合极易产生摩擦。现在安装的新工具很可能会引发兼容性错误。

omens.omen_en: Do not set up a complicated new home appliance or office tech.
omens.omen_zh: 不要布置复杂的新家电或办公室科技设备。
omens.detail_en: Calibration will be off. You will spend more time troubleshooting the setup than actually using the new equipment.
omens.detail_zh: 校准会出现偏差。你花在排除安装故障上的时间将远远超过实际使用新设备的时间。

omens.omen_en: Avoid setting up new access controls or user permission levels.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不宜设置新的准入控制或用户权限等级。
omens.detail_en: The 'gate' you build today may accidentally lock out the wrong people. Restrictive policies created now will cause friction later.
omens.detail_zh: 你今日建立的‘大门’可能会意外地将错误的人拒之门外。现在创建的限制性政策日后会引发摩擦。

omens.omen_en: Do not launch a restricted 'invite-only' feature today.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不要发布受限的‘仅限邀请’功能。
omens.detail_en: Gating your project today creates unnecessary barriers to growth. Wait for a more 'open' day to define your boundaries.
omens.detail_zh: 今日为项目设置门槛会为增长制造不必要的障碍。请等待更‘开放’的日子再来界定边界。

omens.omen_en: Avoid establishing a new 'ritual' or cultural practice for your team.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不宜为团队确立新的‘仪式’或文化惯例。
omens.detail_en: Setting a spiritual or cultural foundation today lacks depth. The new tradition will feel hollow and fail to inspire long-term loyalty.
omens.detail_zh: 今日确立的精神或文化基础缺乏深度。新的传统会显得空洞，无法激发长期的忠诚度。

omens.omen_en: Do not finalize your brand's mission statement or core purpose.
omens.omen_zh: 不要定稿品牌的使命宣言或核心宗旨。
omens.detail_en: The 'essence' of your work is hard to capture today. A statement written now will feel misaligned with your true goals by next month.
omens.detail_zh: 今日很难捕捉到工作的‘精髓’。现在撰写的声明到下个月就会让你觉得与真实目标不一致。

omens.omen_en: Avoid finalizing the contract for a major service provider.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不宜与主要的系统服务商定稿合同。
omens.detail_en: The 'stone foundation' is unstable. Committing to a specific provider today may lock you into a rigid system that can't scale.
omens.detail_zh: ‘石基’不稳。今日向特定服务商做出承诺，可能会让你陷入一个无法扩展的僵化系统中。

omens.omen_en: Do not choose the primary tech stack for a new long-term project.
omens.omen_zh: 不要为一个新的长期项目选择主技术栈。
omens.detail_en: Decisions made today lack the necessary foresight. You may find that the chosen foundation is incompatible with future requirements.
omens.detail_zh: 今日做出的决策缺乏必要的预见性。你可能会发现所选的基础与未来的需求不兼容。

omens.omen_en: Avoid dipping into your emergency funds or primary savings.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不宜动用紧急基金或主要储蓄。
omens.detail_en: Opening the 'granary' today leads to a persistent leak. Resources spent now will be difficult to replenish in the coming months.
omens.detail_zh: 今日‘开仓’会导致持续的流失。现在耗费的资源在接下来的几个月里将很难补充。

omens.omen_en: Avoid making a large purchase from your primary savings.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不宜动用主要储蓄进行大额消费。
omens.detail_en: Opening the 'granary' today leads to a long-term drain. Money spent now will be much harder to replace than you anticipate.
omens.detail_zh: 今日‘开仓’会导致长期的财务流失。现在花掉的钱会比你预想的更难补回。

omens.omen_en: Avoid 'revealing' the final design of a high-stakes project.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不宜‘揭晓’高风险项目的最终设计。
omens.detail_en: The energy of 'awakening' is distorted today. A reveal now will likely be misunderstood or fail to capture the intended aesthetic impact.
omens.detail_zh: 今日‘开光’的能量是扭曲的。现在的揭晓很可能会被误解，或无法产生预期的美学冲击力。

omens.omen_en: Do not finalize the branding colors or logo for a new venture.
omens.omen_zh: 不要定稿新创业项目的品牌色彩或 Logo。
omens.detail_en: The 'eye' of the brand is clouded today. Choices made now will feel dull or uninspiring once the current energy shifts.
omens.detail_zh: 品牌之‘眼’今日晦暗。一旦当前的能量发生转变，现在做出的选择会显得平淡无奇。

omens.omen_en: Avoid starting a new collection or opening a large storage unit.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不宜开始新的收藏或启用大型储物柜。
omens.detail_en: A 'pool' created today attracts stagnant energy. Your new storage or collection will likely become cluttered and disorganized quickly.
omens.detail_zh: 今日开启的‘池子’易招致停滞。你的新储物空间或收藏品很可能会迅速变得杂乱无章。

omens.omen_en: Do not finalize the design for a new water feature or pool.
omens.omen_zh: 不要在今日敲定新水景或泳池的设计。
omens.detail_en: Hidden structural weaknesses are likely to be ignored today. What you build now will eventually cause dampness or foundation issues.
omens.detail_zh: 今日极易忽视隐蔽的结构弱点。现在建造的工程最终会导致潮湿或地基问题。

omens.omen_en: Avoid establishing new automated data pipelines or APIs.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不宜建立新的自动化数据管道或 API。
omens.detail_en: Diverting the flow today leads to unexpected drainage. A 'channel' created now may inadvertently leak sensitive data to the wrong systems.
omens.detail_zh: 今日改道会导致意外流失。现在建立的‘渠道’可能会无意中将敏感数据泄露给错误的系统。

omens.omen_en: Do not sign a contract with a new marketing or distribution channel.
omens.omen_zh: 不要与新的营销或分销渠道签署合同。
omens.detail_en: The flow of resources is unstable today. This new channel will likely consume more effort than the results it delivers.
omens.detail_zh: 今日资源流转不稳。这个新渠道消耗的精力极可能远超其带来的回报。

omens.omen_en: Avoid fixating on 'worst-case scenario' planning for your career.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不宜过度纠结于职业生涯的‘最坏打算’。
omens.detail_en: Preparing for a future 'end' today attracts morbid energy. Obsessing over failure now prevents you from taking the risks needed for growth.
omens.detail_zh: 今日为未来的‘终结’做准备会吸引负面能量。现在过度担心失败会阻碍你承担成长所需的风险。

omens.omen_en: Do not purchase long-term plots or funeral insurance today.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不要购买长期墓地或丧葬保险。
omens.detail_en: Decisions about the distant future are clouded. You are likely to overpay or choose a location that doesn't fit your long-term legacy.
omens.detail_zh: 今日关于遥远未来的决策十分模糊。你很可能会支付过高的费用，或选择一个不符合长期规划的位置。

omens.omen_en: Avoid assuming a major new legal or financial responsibility today.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不宜承担重大的新法律或财务责任。
omens.detail_en: The transition to 'adulthood' is rocky today. Taking on a heavy burden now will lead to long-term stress and a feeling of being trapped.
omens.detail_zh: 今日迈向‘成人’的转变并不顺遂。现在承担重担会导致长期的压力和被困住的感觉。

omens.omen_en: Do not hold an official 'launch' party or celebration of maturity.
omens.omen_zh: 不要举行正式的‘启动’派对或庆祝成熟的仪式。
omens.detail_en: Public ceremonies today lack the intended gravitas. The celebration will likely be met with lukewarm energy or logistical hiccups.
omens.detail_zh: 今日的公开仪式缺乏应有的庄重。庆祝活动很可能会遭遇能量低迷或物流小状况。

omens.omen_en: Avoid adopting a 'defensive' or mourning-like posture at work.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不宜在工作中表现出‘防御性’或如丧考妣的姿态。
omens.detail_en: Putting on 'mourning dress' today traps you in a cycle of grief. Do not let a recent setback define your professional persona.
omens.detail_zh: 今日‘成服’会将你困在悲伤的循环中。不要让最近的一次挫折定义了你的职业形象。

omens.omen_en: Do not accept the finality of a current business loss today.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不要接受当前业务损失已成定局的想法。
omens.detail_en: Formally mourning a project now is premature. There may still be a 'pulse' in the initiative that you can't see under today's energy.
omens.detail_zh: 现在正式放弃项目为时过早。在此能量下，该方案可能还存在你尚未察觉的‘脉搏’。

omens.omen_en: Avoid a radical purge of your belongings or 'spring cleaning'.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不宜对财物进行彻底清理或大规模‘大扫除’。
omens.detail_en: Cleaning today is too aggressive. You are likely to throw away something vital or break a valuable item in your haste to be tidy.
omens.detail_zh: 今日的清理过于激进。在匆忙追求整洁的过程中，你很可能会丢掉重要的东西或损坏贵重物品。

omens.omen_en: Do not perform a mass 'unsubscribe' from professional newsletters.
omens.omen_zh: 不要对职业简报进行大规模‘退订’。
omens.detail_en: In your quest to clear clutter, you may cut off a vital source of market intelligence. Be selective rather than exhaustive.
omens.detail_zh: 在追求整洁的过程中，你可能会切断一个关键的市场情报来源。请有选择性地处理，而非一扫而空。

omens.omen_en: Avoid aggressive lead generation or mass cold-emailing.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不宜进行激进的线索挖掘或大规模冷邮件群发。
omens.detail_en: Casting a wide net today will only catch 'trash' (spam complaints). Your efforts to find new users will backfire and hurt your reputation.
omens.detail_zh: 今日广泛撒网只会捞到‘垃圾’（垃圾邮件投诉）。你寻找新用户的努力会适得其反，损害你的声望。

omens.omen_en: Do not invest in 'get rich quick' schemes or speculative tips.
omens.omen_zh: 不要投资‘快速致富’计划或投机性消息。
omens.detail_en: The 'waters' are deceptive today. Trying to catch an easy win will result in losing your current resources to a more experienced predator.
omens.detail_zh: 今日‘水况’具有欺骗性。试图轻取胜利会导致你现有的资源流向更有经验的掠食者。

omens.omen_en: Avoid publicly announcing a major new rebranding or title change.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不宜公开宣布重大的品牌重塑或头衔变更。
omens.detail_en: Hanging your 'sign' today invites unwanted scrutiny. The new identity will likely feel misaligned with your core values within weeks.
omens.detail_zh: 今日‘挂匾’会招来不必要的审视。新身份很可能在几周内就会让你觉得与核心价值观不符。

omens.omen_en: Do not update your LinkedIn 'Headline' or professional bio today.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不要更新你的 LinkedIn ‘头衔’或职业简介。
omens.detail_en: Visual prestige is blocked. Your new description will likely be misunderstood or ignored by those who matter most in your network.
omens.detail_zh: 视觉声望受阻。你的新描述很可能会被网络中最重要的那些人误解或忽视。

omens.omen_en: Avoid starting a deep-dive research project into a new field.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不宜开启对新领域的深度研究项目。
omens.detail_en: Digging for 'new water' today will result in a dry hole. You will spend immense energy without finding a sustainable source of knowledge.
omens.detail_zh: 今日挖掘‘新水源’只会挖到枯井。你会耗费巨大精力却找不到可持续的知识源泉。

omens.omen_en: Do not establish a new recurring revenue source or subscription model.
omens.omen_zh: 不要建立新的经常性收入来源或订阅模型。
omens.detail_en: The 'well' created today will quickly run dry. The initial interest will not translate into the long-term flow you are expecting.
omens.detail_zh: 今日挖掘的‘井’会很快干涸。最初的兴趣无法转化为你所期待的长期流量。

omens.omen_en: Avoid moving your physical workspace or server rack today.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不宜搬动你的物理办公空间或服务器机架。
omens.detail_en: Disrupting your 'flow' today leads to prolonged disorientation. Moving now will result in missing cables, broken peripherals, or a chaotic setup.
omens.detail_zh: 今日扰动你的‘气场’会导致长时间的迷失。现在搬迁会导致线缆丢失、外设损坏或环境混乱。

omens.omen_en: Do not sign a new residential or commercial lease today.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不宜签署新的住宅或商业租赁合同。
omens.detail_en: The foundation of the 'new home' is spiritually unstable today. You may find hidden issues with the neighbors or the property infrastructure later.
omens.detail_zh: 今日‘新家’的根基在精神层面并不稳定。你日后可能会发现邻里关系或房产基础设施存在隐患。

omens.omen_en: Postpone your official 'Housewarming' or office opening party.
omens.omen_zh: 推迟你的正式‘乔迁之喜’或办公室开幕派对。
omens.detail_en: Entering a new space today attracts 'stale' energy rather than fresh starts. The celebration will feel forced and fail to spark new inspiration.
omens.detail_zh: 今日进入新空间吸引的是‘陈旧’之气而非新气象。庆祝活动会显得牵强，且无法激发新的灵感。

omens.omen_en: Avoid finalizing the interior layout of a new studio or shop.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不宜定稿新工作室或店面的内部布局。
omens.detail_en: Spatial judgment is skewed. The layout you choose today will eventually feel restrictive to your movement and productivity.
omens.detail_zh: 空间判断力出现偏差。你今日选择的布局最终会让你感到行动受限，影响生产力。

omens.omen_en: Avoid taking over a legacy project or 'adopting' someone else's code.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不宜接手遗留项目或‘收编’他人的代码。
omens.detail_en: Taking responsibility for what you didn't create today brings hidden burdens. You will find it much harder to 'bond' with the project than expected.
omens.detail_zh: 今日对他人的产出承担责任会带来隐形负担。你会发现与该项目的‘磨合’远比预期要难。

omens.omen_en: Do not finalize adoption papers or new guardianship roles today.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不要定稿收养文件或新的监护人身份。
omens.detail_en: The long-term karmic bond is clouded today. This new relationship may start with fundamental misunderstandings that persist for years.
omens.detail_zh: 今日长期的因缘纽带模糊不清。这段新关系可能从根本性的误解开始，并持续数年。

omens.omen_en: Avoid performing 'cleansing' rituals or spiritual ceremonies today.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不宜进行‘净化’仪式或精神祭奠。
omens.detail_en: The connection to the divine is cluttered today. Your efforts to seek spiritual clarity will likely result in more confusion or 'spiritual noise'.
omens.detail_zh: 今日与神圣层面的连接杂乱无章。你寻求精神清明的努力很可能会导致更多的困惑或‘精神噪音’。

omens.omen_en: Do not commit to a strict religious or dietary fast starting today.
omens.omen_zh: 不要从今日开始进行严格的宗教禁食或饮食节制。
omens.detail_en: The body and spirit are out of sync today. Starting a fast now will likely lead to physical illness rather than spiritual elevation.
omens.detail_zh: 今日身心并不同步。现在开始斋戒很可能会导致身体不适，而非精神升华。

omens.omen_en: Avoid setting up temporary scaffolding or staging environments.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不宜搭建临时脚手架或预发布环境。
omens.detail_en: Support structures are inherently weak today. A 'staging' site created now will likely fail under the weight of actual testing data.
omens.detail_zh: 今日的支撑结构天生脆弱。现在建立的‘预发布’站点很可能会在实际测试数据的压力下崩溃。

omens.omen_en: Do not rely on a 'temporary' fix for a critical system error.
omens.omen_zh: 不要对关键系统错误依赖‘临时’修复方案。
omens.detail_en: The 'horse stand' (scaffolding) will buckle. A quick patch applied today will cause a massive structural collapse later in the week.
omens.detail_zh: ‘架马’（脚手架）会弯曲。今日应用的快速补丁会在本周晚些时候引发大规模的结构性崩溃。

omens.omen_en: Avoid planting the 'seeds' of a new passive income stream today.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不宜为新的被动收入流‘播种’。
omens.detail_en: The soil is sterile today. Efforts made to plant a long-term 'tree' of wealth will fail to take root or produce fruit.
omens.detail_zh: 今日土壤贫瘠。为建立长期财富‘树’所做的努力将难以生根或结果。

omens.omen_en: Do not start a new gardening project or indoor plant collection.
omens.omen_zh: 不要开始新的园艺项目或室内植物收藏。
omens.detail_en: Living things struggle to adapt under today's energy. New plants introduced now are highly likely to wither within the month.
omens.detail_zh: 生物在今日的能量下难以适应。现在引入的新植物极有可能在一个月内枯萎。

omens.omen_en: Avoid submitting a high-value job application or school essay today.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不宜提交高价值的求职申请或入学论文。
omens.detail_en: Your 'credentials' will be overlooked or misunderstood today. Wait for a day with better self-expression energy to present your profile.
omens.detail_zh: 你的‘资历’今日会被忽视或误解。请等待一个自我表达能量更好的日子再展示你的履历。

omens.omen_en: Do not enroll in a new expensive course or certification today.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不要报名参加昂贵的新课程或认证考试。
omens.detail_en: The commitment to learning is unstable today. You may find the subject matter uninteresting or the certification less valuable than promised.
omens.detail_zh: 今日对学习的承诺并不稳固。你可能会发现课题乏味，或者证书的价值远低于承诺。

omens.omen_en: Avoid starting an aggressive new medical therapy or elective surgery.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不宜开启激进的新医疗方案或选择性手术。
omens.detail_en: Healing energy is redirected elsewhere today. Procedures performed now carry a higher risk of prolonged recovery or side effects.
omens.detail_zh: 今日愈合能量被引向了他处。现在进行的医疗程序带有更高的恢复期延长或副作用风险。

omens.omen_en: Do not consult a new doctor for a chronic, long-term issue today.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不宜就长期的慢性问题咨询新医生。
omens.detail_en: Diagnosis will be foggy today. You may receive advice that addresses the symptoms but misses the systemic root cause.
omens.detail_zh: 今日的诊断会很模糊。你收到的建议可能只是对症下药，却忽略了系统性的根源。

omens.omen_en: Avoid expanding your social media following or community 'herd'.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不宜扩大你的社交媒体粉丝量或社区‘族群’。
omens.detail_en: New members acquired today will be difficult to manage. The 'flock' will be prone to infighting or toxicity under today's energy.
omens.detail_zh: 今日获取的新成员将难以管理。在此能量下，‘族群’极易发生内斗或产生负能量。

omens.omen_en: Do not buy or adopt a new pet today.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不要购买或领养新宠物。
omens.detail_en: The animal will struggle to bond with you. The 'herding' energy is chaotic, leading to behavioral issues or health problems for the new arrival.
omens.detail_zh: 小动物会很难与你建立纽带。‘牧养’能量混乱，会导致新成员出现行为问题或健康隐患。

omens.omen_en: Avoid finalizing the roofing or top-level deployment of a project.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不宜完成项目的封顶或顶层部署。
omens.detail_en: The 'roof' provides protection. Completing it today creates a ceiling that is prone to 'leaking' sensitive data or failing under external pressure.
omens.detail_zh: ‘屋顶’提供保护。今日完工会造成顶层脆弱，极易泄露敏感数据或在外部压力下崩溃。

omens.omen_en: Do not sign a contract for major home or office roofing work.
omens.omen_zh: 不要在今日签署重大的房屋或办公室屋顶工程合同。
omens.detail_en: Materials chosen today will be of inferior quality. You may find yourself paying for repairs far sooner than expected.
omens.detail_zh: 今日选用的材料质量堪忧。你可能会发现，需要维修的时间比预想的要早得多。

omens.omen_en: Avoid moving historical records or sensitive archives today.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不宜搬动历史记录或敏感档案。
omens.detail_en: Moving what should remain at rest invites chaos. Files or artifacts moved today are at high risk of being lost, corrupted, or damaged forever.
omens.detail_zh: 搬动本该安息之物会招致混乱。今日迁移的文件或文物面临极高的丢失、损坏或永久损坏风险。

omens.omen_en: Do not transfer ownership of a 'dead' or dormant company today.
omens.omen_zh: 不要在今日转让一家‘已死’或休眠公司的所有权。
omens.detail_en: Transferring the remains of a business today will carry its previous failures into the new structure, infecting your future success.
omens.detail_zh: 今日转让业务残余会将过去的失败带入新结构，从而影响你未来的成功。

omens.omen_en: Avoid finalizing a permanent 'About Me' page or bio.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不宜定稿永久性的‘关于我’页面或简介。
omens.detail_en: Erecting a 'monument' to yourself today is premature. Your identity is still shifting, and the words chosen now will feel restrictive very soon.
omens.detail_zh: 今日为自己树立‘纪念碑’为时过早。你的身份仍在转变，现在选择的措辞很快就会让你感到受限。

omens.omen_en: Do not order a physical plaque or sign for your business today.
omens.omen_zh: 不要为你的业务订购实体牌匾或标识。
omens.detail_en: Inscriptions made today are prone to typos or design errors that cannot be easily fixed. Wait for a day of greater clarity.
omens.detail_zh: 今日刻下的文字极易出现拼写或设计错误且难以修复。请等待头脑更清醒的日子。

omens.omen_en: Avoid appointing a new Chief Executive or primary leader.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不宜任命新的首席执行官或主要领导者。
omens.detail_en: The 'pillars' of your organization must be perfectly straight. A leader appointed today will struggle to hold up the weight of the company.
omens.detail_zh: 组织的‘支柱’必须绝对正直。今日任命的领导者将难以承受公司的重压。

omens.omen_en: Avoid assigning a primary leader for a group trip or event.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不宜为团体旅行或活动指定主要负责人。
omens.detail_en: The 'pillar' of the group must be strong. A leader chosen today will struggle to maintain authority or handle the pressure of the role.
omens.detail_zh: 团体的‘支柱’必须强有力。今日选出的负责人将难以维持权威或承受该角色的压力。

omens.omen_en: Avoid a hasty apology to fix a damaged relationship.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不宜为了修复受损的关系而仓促道歉。
omens.detail_en: Mending walls in a rush today will look like a 'patch job'. Your sincerity may be doubted if the fix is not thoughtful.
omens.detail_zh: 今日仓促修补关系会被视为‘敷衍了事’。如果修补不够走心，你的诚意可能会遭到怀疑。

omens.omen_en: Do not attempt to repair a damaged professional relationship in haste.
omens.omen_zh: 不要在匆忙中尝试修复受损的职业关系。
omens.detail_en: The timing for reconciliation is off. Your attempt to mend the fence will be perceived as insincere or desperate. Wait for a more neutral day.
omens.detail_zh: 和解的时机不对。你修补关系的尝试会被视为缺乏诚意或由于绝望。请等待更中性的日子。

omens.omen_en: Avoid holding a formal ceremony to thank donors or investors.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不宜举行正式仪式来感谢捐助者或投资者。
omens.detail_en: The energy of 'gratitude' is misaligned today. Your thanks may be perceived as a subtle request for more funds, leading to awkward tensions.
omens.detail_zh: 今日‘感激’的能量发生了偏差。你的感谢可能会被解读为含蓄的索要更多资金，从而导致尴尬的紧张局势。

omens.omen_en: Do not pay off a large debt or final project installment today.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不要偿还大额债务或支付项目尾款。
omens.detail_en: Settling the 'ground debt' today leads to a cycle of needing more loans. Keep your liquidity for a few more days to maintain your financial safety net.
omens.detail_zh: 今日偿还‘旧债’会导致陷入需要更多贷款的循环。请再保持几天的流动性，以维持你的财务安全网。

omens.omen_en: Avoid rearranging your long-term insurance or retirement funds.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不宜重新调整你的长期保险或养老基金。
omens.detail_en: Moving your 'final' safety net today is high risk. You may inadvertently lose critical benefits or lock yourself into an inferior plan due to clerical errors.
omens.detail_zh: 今日挪动‘最后’的安全网风险极高。你可能会因为文书错误而不经意间失去关键利益，或被困于一份糟糕的计划中。

omens.omen_en: Avoid moving sensitive financial accounts or long-term investments.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不宜转移敏感的财务账户或长期投资。
omens.detail_en: Moving your 'foundation' today invites loss. You may encounter hidden fees or administrative errors that jeopardize your assets.
omens.detail_zh: 今日挪动‘根基’会招致损失。你可能会遇到隐藏费用或行政错误，从而危害你的资产。

omens.omen_en: Avoid finalizing the mission statement for a non-profit venture.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不宜定稿非营利企业的使命宣言。
omens.detail_en: The 'temple' of your values is under construction. Writing the core purpose today will lead to a document that feels insincere or hypocritical.
omens.detail_zh: 你价值观的‘殿堂’正在建设中。今日撰写核心宗旨会导致一份让人感到虚伪或言不由衷的文件。

omens.omen_en: Do not commission religious or spiritual artwork for your space.
omens.omen_zh: 不要为你的空间委派宗教或精神艺术品的创作。
omens.detail_en: The sacred connection is blocked. Artwork created or installed today will hold a heavy, stagnant energy instead of inspiring peace.
omens.detail_zh: 神圣的连接被阻断了。今日创作或安装的艺术品会带有一种沉重、停滞的能量，而非激发宁静。

omens.omen_en: Avoid introducing two friends who don't know each other yet.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不宜介绍互不相识的两位朋友认识。
omens.detail_en: The 'bridge' you try to build between people today will be shaky. The introduction is likely to lead to awkwardness or future friction.
omens.detail_zh: 今日你试图在人与人之间搭建的‘桥梁’并不稳固。这种引荐极易导致尴尬或日后的摩擦。

omens.omen_en: Do not introduce two separate teams or potential partners today.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不要介绍两个独立的团队或潜在合作伙伴认识。
omens.detail_en: The connection you try to forge today will be fraught with friction. The 'bridge' between these parties will fail to support long-term traffic.
omens.detail_zh: 你今日试图建立的连接会充满摩擦。这些当事方之间的‘桥梁’将无法承载长期的沟通往来。

omens.omen_en: Avoid setting up new shared workspaces or team communication channels.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不宜建立新的共享工作空间或团队沟通渠道。
omens.detail_en: Constructing an 'enclosure' for your team today will lead to a feeling of being trapped. Toxicity will breed faster in confined digital spaces created now.
omens.detail_zh: 今日为团队构建‘圈舍’会导致被困感。在现在创建的受限数字空间里，负能量会滋生得更快。

omens.omen_en: Avoid setting up a new shared living arrangement or pet area.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不宜建立新的共同居住安排或宠物生活区。
omens.detail_en: Space defined today will feel restrictive. Those sharing the area will likely experience friction over boundaries very soon.
omens.detail_zh: 今日定义的‘空间’会让人感到束缚。共享该区域的人很快就会在边界问题上产生摩擦。

omens.omen_en: Avoid launching a new website or mobile app platform.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不宜发布新的网站或移动应用平台。
omens.detail_en: The 'vessel' you launch today is prone to leaks. Hidden bugs in the core architecture will cause the platform to sink under its first wave of users.
omens.detail_zh: 你今日启动的‘载具’极易出现漏洞。核心架构中隐藏的 Bug 会导致平台在第一波用户涌入时就‘沉没’。

omens.omen_en: Do not invest in new logistics or shipping infrastructure today.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不要投资新的物流或航运基础设施。
omens.detail_en: The tools meant to carry your business forward are unstable. Any 'ship' built or bought today will face unexpected maintenance costs and delays.
omens.detail_zh: 旨在推动业务发展的工具并不稳定。今日建造或购买的任何‘船只’都会面临意外的维护成本和延误。

omens.omen_en: Avoid attempting precision 'hot-fixes' on a live system.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不宜在生产系统上尝试精确的‘热修复’。
omens.detail_en: One small 'needle' in the wrong place today will paralyze the entire network. Save high-precision adjustments for a day of greater clarity.
omens.detail_zh: 今日在错误的位置刺入一根‘细针’就会导致整个网络瘫痪。请将高精度调整留到头脑更清醒的日子。

omens.omen_en: Do not start a new habit involving micro-management or extreme detail.
omens.omen_zh: 不要开始涉及微观管理或极端细节的新习惯。
omens.detail_en: Focusing too intensely on the 'points' today will cause you to lose sight of the whole body of work. You will likely cause more pain than healing.
omens.detail_zh: 今日过度关注‘点’会导致你忽视工作的整体。你造成的痛苦可能会多于疗愈。

omens.omen_en: Avoid taking on any task that is not on your pre-approved list.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不宜承担任何不在预先批准清单上的任务。
omens.detail_en: Extra activities today are a trap for your time and energy. Stick strictly to maintenance and avoid all 'shiny new objects'.
omens.detail_zh: 今日额外的活动是时间和能量的陷阱。请严格坚持维护工作，避开所有‘华而不实的新事物’。

omens.omen_en: Do not say 'Yes' to any spontaneous meetings or requests.
omens.omen_zh: 今日不要对任何自发的会议或请求说‘好’。
omens.detail_en: The universe is in a chaotic state. Any new commitment made now—no matter how small—will balloon into an unmanageable burden.
omens.detail_zh: 宇宙正处于混乱状态。现在做出的任何新承诺——无论多么微小——都会膨胀成难以承受的重担。
